review_findings.finding: New draft freshness initially did not cover the two placeholder files consumed by the diagnostic.
review_findings.resolution: New helper now hashes placeholders_skip.txt and placeholders_localcapture.txt; dedicated guard test covers both. Existing edition signature unchanged.

review_findings.finding: Old probe_ruby widget default could silently reintroduce diagnostic text after page cleanup.
review_findings.resolution: Removed implicit default; explicit import plus retention of the actual existing draft only. New AppTests cover nonempty/whitespace drafts and page roundtrips.

review_findings.finding: Existing forward state test expected old metadata-free save bytes.
review_findings.resolution: Test expectation updated for the intentionally added standard-export tag; final regression report records its rerun.

review_findings.finding: New context-signature failures must not prevent the existing diagnostic rendering.
review_findings.resolution: Signature read failures clear the import candidate only; original diagnosis still runs. A dedicated guard covers the failure path.

reviewed_behavior: Only unchanged bundled standard HTML gets a saved-copy format tag; editable result remains untagged.
Edited output and custom JSON keep prior explicit-direction behavior; no automatic direction inference.
Old HTML retains all result fields and extraction rules; new explicit invalid/mismatched records block stale downloadable results while keeping input.
Empty manual draft is imported only by button; normalized single-word equality, data/correction/edition freshness and callback recheck guard it.
Import changes session draft only; saving a correction remains separate; existing nonempty and whitespace drafts remain unchanged.
execution_attribution: New manual and generated-HTML AppTests were executed by their implementation owners; this independent auditor reviewed test source and verified the saved passing reports/current helper hashes. Complete inverse suites, old-parser comparisons, bundled/raw actual engine checks, existing forward regression and source invariants are independently executed in the separate audit reports.
